summary: Smart Lead Scoring V1 tested end-to-end. 18/18 backend pytest cases passed and frontend UI validated for Leads (badge/filter/sort), Lead Detail (quality score + Why breakdown + manual override + auto revert), and Event Dashboard (quality distribution, top_leads exclusions, leaderboard hot_leads/avg_score). Manual override HOT preserves the calculated score (49/100 warm) and Auto reverts to calculated temperature. Tenant isolation 403 confirmed. All existing leads carry lead_score_version=v1 (backfill OK).
critical_code_review_comments: compute_lead_score / recalc_lead_score cleanly separated; recalc hooked in all mutation paths (status, fields, follow-up, meeting book/cancel). Good.
Manual override stored on lead_temperature_override + effective_temperature() helper; calc score/lead_temperature never mutated by override — matches spec.
Not-Interested cap<=20 enforced after summation; verified.
multiple_interactions capped at 10 (verified with 6 rescans of same lead in GITEX).
Event dashboard aggregates in-process from a single leads fetch — response <5s in tests. Considered adequate; upstream aggregation pipeline could be added later if lead volumes grow.
platform_v1.py is 4445 lines — recommend module split (scoring vs events vs scans) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Test leads created via /api/scan/confirm under feras-askar (TEST_ prefixed) then cleaned up via test_zz_cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_lead_scoring.py — 18 pytest cases covering TEST 1-20 (5&6 collapsed into stage-based recalc since REST meeting creation requires public booking + calendar; 18 not automated because it's a visual mobile-viewport check that was manually confirmed via 430px screenshot). Frontend selectors confirmed: leads-filter-temp, leads-sort, lead-temp-<id>, detail-quality, detail-temp, detail-quality-why, detail-temp-hot/warm/cold/auto, detail-stage, event-quality, quality-hot/warm/cold, event-top-leads, top-lead-<id>, event-leaderboard.
